# Bridges Industrial

> Bridges Industrial is an industrial automation, instrumentation, and technical training company in League City, Texas. Through its PragOptics group it also builds custom field-data hardware, writes control logic for one-off projects, and runs short production batches in photopolymer resin. Contact: support@fortiviewholdings.com, +1 (832) 425-0421.

Bridges Industrial designs, integrates, and services industrial automation and instrumentation systems, and provides hands-on technical training including community-college instruction. Alongside that field work, the company builds things: custom hardware for field data capture, function and control logic for custom projects, custom hardware for products, and one-off or short-run production parts printed by MSLA in photopolymer resin.

PragOptics is the named internal group that handles the hardware and software side of the business. It develops open field hardware — OmniBus, a universal vendor-neutral HART communicator and calibration recorder, and OmniSource, a pocket loop-power supply — which can be bought assembled or built free from published schematics, BOMs, and print-ready case files. PragOptics also runs a studio for building, publishing, and monetizing websites, web apps, and APIs, plus Field Node Manager for pairing software with hardware, a 3D Suite for modeling and slicing, and business automation, managed Microsoft 365, dashboards, and connected apps.

Bridges Industrial also runs the Idea Lab, a free coding and cybersecurity academy for kids, and publishes the Field Pocket Guide, a free set of instrumentation calculators.

Note on naming: the company was formerly **Fortiview Holdings** and the site formerly lived at fortiviewholdings.com. Bridges Industrial is the same company under a new name; the old domain now redirects here. Company email remains @fortiviewholdings.com.

## Services
- **Industrial automation and instrumentation** — calibration, configuration, and troubleshooting; pneumatic, digital, and smart devices for flow, level, temperature, and analytical measurement; Coriolis, magnetic flow, ultrasonic, radar, and guided-wave radar transmitters; HART communication and smart transmitter diagnostics; startup, commissioning, and loop verification across all major OEM platforms.
- **Control logic development** — PLC and DCS logic, motor and relay logic, interlocks, PID loop tuning and control strategy, safety instrumented functions, and custom sequence or batch logic for one-off machines.
- **Custom hardware design and build** — field-data capture devices, control boards, and enclosures. Schematic capture, PCB layout, board bring-up, firmware and embedded logic, enclosure design, and assembly. One-off prototypes through short production batches.
- **MSLA printing and short-run production** — masked stereolithography in photopolymer resin, for parts needing fine feature detail and smooth surface finish: prototypes, custom enclosures and housings, jigs and fixtures, replacement or discontinued components, and one-off production runs.
- **Technical training** — hands-on instrumentation and controls instruction, including community-college teaching, so teams can own the systems they run.
- **Software and integration** — custom APIs and system bridges, dashboards and analytics, managed Microsoft 365, websites and web apps, and connected app development, delivered through PragOptics.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://bridgesindust.com/): What Bridges Industrial does, across all four arms.
- [Industrial Automation & Technical Training](https://bridgesindust.com/industrial/): Instrumentation and controls, PLC and DCS, motor and relay logic, calibration, PID and safety instrumented functions, IT/OT integration, and hands-on technical training. Fifteen years of field experience.
- [Partnerships](https://bridgesindust.com/partnerships/): A vetted network of vendors and integrators. Vendor network, bulk procurement, co-selling, referrals, integration partners.
- [PragOptics](https://bridgesindust.com/integration/): The hardware and software group. Open hardware (OmniBus, the universal HART communicator and calibration recorder; OmniSource, the pocket loop-power supply) sold assembled or built free from published designs; custom hardware and control logic for one-off projects; MSLA resin production runs; the PragOptics studio for websites, web apps, and APIs; Field Node Manager; the 3D Suite for modeling and slicing; plus automation and workflows, managed Microsoft 365, dashboards, security and audit, and iOS and connected apps. Tiers are User at $7.50, Partner at $49, and Super at $350 per user per month, with 10 percent off annual billing. Subscribe and manage at https://pragoptics.com.
- [Idea Lab](https://bridgesindust.com/idea-lab/): A free, cosmic coding and cybersecurity academy for kids. Teaches how a rock becomes a computer, online safety, how AI works, and how to launch an idea. No accounts, no cost, runs in the browser.
- [Field Pocket Guide](https://bridgesindust.com/education/): Free instrumentation calculators and reference tables. No accounts, runs in the browser, works offline once loaded.

## Field Pocket Guide tools
- [Calibration Error](https://bridgesindust.com/education/calibration/): Multi-point As-Found / As-Left worksheet. Error as percent of span, with pass/fail against a tolerance you set. Handles compound and reverse-acting ranges.
- [Signal Scaling](https://bridgesindust.com/education/scaling/): Two-way linear scaling between any input and output span. 4-20 mA to engineering units and back, with percent of span.
- [Square-Root Extraction](https://bridgesindust.com/education/square-root/): Differential-pressure flow, both directions, showing DP-linear and flow-extracted mA side by side.
- [RTD Tables](https://bridgesindust.com/education/rtd/): Pt100, Pt500 and Pt1000 resistance against temperature per IEC 60751 (alpha 0.00385), Callendar-Van Dusen. Table generation and single-reading conversion either way.
- [Thermocouple Tables](https://bridgesindust.com/education/thermocouple/): Types J, K, T, E, N, R, S and B. Millivolts against temperature per ITS-90, reference junction 0 °C, with cold-junction compensation.
- [Field Formulas](https://bridgesindust.com/education/formulas/): The working set of instrumentation formulas with worked examples: percent of span, mA conversions, scaling, square root, calibration error, turndown, RTD and thermocouple basics, Ohm's law and loop burden.
- [Numbering Systems](https://bridgesindust.com/education/numbering-systems/): Interactive lab for binary, octal, hexadecimal, BCD, ASCII and two's complement, with a master any-base converter that shows every step of the work, an ADC sampling bench, successive division, bit grouping, column arithmetic, and a practice problem generator.

## Idea Lab wings
- [The Foundry](https://bridgesindust.com/idea-lab/foundry/): How a rock becomes a computer — binary, logic gates, adders, memory, pixels, CPUs, and a first program.
- [Defense Wing](https://bridgesindust.com/idea-lab/defense/): Staying safe online — passwords, two-factor authentication, phishing, HTTPS, cookies, privacy, threat modeling, and responsible disclosure.
- [AI Wing](https://bridgesindust.com/idea-lab/ai-wing/): How AI actually works — prediction, prompts, hallucinations, bias, provenance, telling real from generated, and using AI responsibly.
- [Mission](https://bridgesindust.com/idea-lab/mission/): Turning an idea into something real.
- [Starcharts](https://bridgesindust.com/idea-lab/starcharts/): Progress tracking across the wings.
